evidence.summary: Official Manchester academic and SJT screening followed by UCAT cognitive-total ranking in separate applicant cohorts. International bands use verified historical international interview competitiveness and are not a fixed UCAT cut-off, probability or interview guarantee.

eligibility.scope: Banding applies only after every applicable production eligibility rule passes, UCAT is present for the application cycle, SJT Band 1 or 2 is confirmed, and a supported applicant pool is resolved.
pre_banding_order: Evaluate all applicable academic and contextual eligibility rules from the production profile.
Require UCAT in the application cycle.
Reject SJT Band 3 or Band 4 before selecting a guidance pool or applying a UCAT band.
Allow SJT Band 1 or Band 2 to proceed.
Resolve the separate International, Home standard or verified Home contextual/WP pool.
Apply the matching historical UCAT guidance band.

map_override.condition: The applicant is a verified Manchester Access Programme completer and meets every applicable minimum criterion.
map_override.applicant_facing_explanation: Based on the information provided, you meet the published criteria for a guaranteed interview through the Manchester Access Programme (MAP).
map_override.confirmation_notice: Your verified MAP completion and confirmed current-cycle reduced UCAT threshold meet the published guaranteed-interview requirements.
map_override.notes: The override applies only when structured MAP completion and the current-cycle reduced UCAT threshold are both verified. Historical UCAT guidance must never prove this condition.

unsupported_and_insufficient_evidence_gr: A106 applicants presenting a prior degree where distinct UCAT treatment is not established
Applicants whose Home standard or verified Home contextual/WP pool cannot be resolved

reference_only_exclusions.notes: A101 Graduate Entry remains reference-only and non-executable for A106. A101 UCAT thresholds, places and admissions rules are stored only as reference data.

do_not_infer: Do not treat a historical minimum-invited score as a fixed current or future cutoff.
Do not present a canonical band as a probability or guarantee.
Do not generate prior-degree-applicant bands without matching evidence.
No executable A101 logic is implemented within A106.
Do not apply a UCAT band after SJT Band 3 or Band 4.
Do not replace the MAP guaranteed-interview rule with an ordinary UCAT guidance band.
Do not use arithmetic /3600 to /2700 conversion as evidence of psychometric equivalence.

score_model.basis: Official UCAT cognitive-total interview ranking input after academic eligibility and the SJT Band 1-2 gate; International boundaries are ApplySmart historical guidance and not a fixed UCAT cut-off.

conversion_policy.rounding_policy: Use the research-team-supplied converted equivalents. Preserve raw converted values in the research and production profiles for traceability.
conversion_policy.execution_rule: Converted historical values define guidance ranges only and are never deterministic current-cycle boundaries.

comparison_guidance.label: 2026 WP+ threshold
comparison_guidance.caveat: Manchester's published 2026-entry WP+ threshold was 1960/2700. This is previous-cycle context only, not the 2027 threshold or an interview guarantee.
